project.name: Fireweave PostHog adapter
project.description: PostHog-backed BackendAdapter per ADR-0002. BLOCKED DEPENDENCY: the decision brief pins com.posthog:posthog-server:2.9.0, which does not exist on Maven Central (verified 2026-07-27; only com.posthog:posthog 3.x Android and legacy com.posthog.java:posthog 1.2.0 exist — the latter is explicitly prohibited). The adapter is implemented against the internal PostHogClientApi transport seam (snapshot flag evaluation, explicit context passing — no ThreadLocal); binding the real SDK is a one-class task once the artifact is published. Reported for orchestrator arbitration.
